:::{#exm-dot-product-matmul}
#### Dot product as matrix multiplication

The dot product of two column vectors $\vx$ and $\vcoef$
can be written as a matrix product of the row vector $\tp{\vx}$
with the column vector $\vcoef$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vx \cdot \vcoef
&= \tp{\vx}\, \vcoef
\\ &= [x_1,\; x_2,\; \ldots,\; x_p]
\begin{bmatrix}
\coef{1} \\
\coef{2} \\
\vdots \\
\coef{p}
\end{bmatrix}
\\ &=
x_1\coef{1} + x_2\coef{2} + \cdots + x_p \coef{p}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
